sourceText:
Yakitori Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:05am

Ingredients




2 tablespoons sesame seed, toast 3 minutes in skillet on medium heat
3 lg. chicken breasts, skinned, split and boned
 cup dry sherry
3 tablespoons Oriental sesame oil, or peanut oil
1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger, or powdered
3 tablespoons soy sauce

Preparation

1 Cut chicken into 6-7 chunks from each breast half. Pour 1/4 cup of marinade over chicken and mix. Cover and chill 1-8 hours. 2 Barbecue - thread onto skewers. Discard used marinade. Barbecue on hot coals 10-12 minutes, cut to test. Moisten with reserved marinade and sprinkle with sesame seed. Also, can dip mushrooms or other vegetables and grill briefly with chicken, about 5 minutes. 3 Stir fry marinade chicken with all of marinade. Lift chicken out and stir fry in hot work or skillet, until done (white). Reserve marinade. Mix reserved marinade with 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Add to chicken. Cook sauce until thickened. Add toasted sesame seeds.
